Percent of fast shamblers that are sentient.
Sentient shamblers haul themselves over fences the slow way
rather than hurdling them. Rolled once per zombie.

Percent of sentient zombies that work a door handle instead of
pounding on it. Rolled once per zombie.
Locked and barricaded doors are always thumped as normal, so
locking up is still a real defence.
Separate from the vanilla "Door Opening" lore setting -- if both
are above zero, both apply.

Percent of slow shamblers that are sentient.
These climb noticeably slower than other sentient zombies --
roughly 30% longer on every climb. Rolled once per zombie.

Percent of sprinters that are sentient.
Sentient zombies vault fences and climb through windows on their
feet instead of flopping over them. Rolled once per zombie and
kept for its lifetime.

Percent of sentient zombies that haul themselves over tall fences
and walls -- the ones you press E to climb -- instead of attacking
them. Rolled once per zombie. Set to 0 to disable wall climbing.

Percent of sentient zombies that fling themselves through windows.
They shatter the glass and climb straight in rather than pounding
on it. Rolled once per zombie.
Barricaded windows are always thumped as normal.
